title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Pork Buns
description: A fusion of traditional Vietnamese flavors with a modern twist, these grilled pork buns are perfect for a delicious snack or light meal.
instructions: 2. Slice pork shoulder into thin strips and season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of oil.
3. Grill pork for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast bun pieces on the grill or in a toaster.
5. Spread bun sauce on each toasted bun.
6. Add a few slices of grilled pork, a piece of cha, and a sprinkle of cilantro to each bun.
7. Serve immediately and garnish with a lime wedge and a few fresh mint leaves.
